title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
title_zh: LiveMACE：在动态市场中对 LLM 智能体能力的流程感知评估

paragraphs.en: jzhao.nlp@gmail.com \coderepository https://github.com/RaymondVoldemortFu/LiveMACE
paragraphs.zh: jzhao.nlp@gmail.com \coderepository https://github.com/RaymondVoldemortFu/LiveMACE

paragraphs.en: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench , a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use , Persistent Memory , Rule Following , and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome–capability gap : realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability.
paragraphs.zh: 仅通过结果来评估智能体，可能会掩盖产生这些结果的能力。 这个问题在动态变化的环境中尤为突出，因为结果反映了智能体行为与不断变化的外部条件之间的闭环互动。 我们提出了 LiveMACEBench——一个流程感知的基准测试工具，它利用实时金融市场作为持续演进的自然测试环境，用于评估持续运行的 LLM 智能体。 在匹配的“工具使用”“持久记忆”“规则遵循”和“多智能体协作”配置下，五种前沿 LLM 沿着连续的轨迹运行。 我们通过实际结果以及从完整决策轨迹中得出的机制特定诊断指标来评估它们。 在为期 30 天的实时评估中，我们发现结果与能力之间存在显著差距：实际收益常常偏离能力特定的测量值，而相似的结果也可能源于截然不同的机制使用模式。 轨迹层面的诊断进一步揭示了不同能力之间的独特瓶颈，表明机制访问、有效机制使用以及下游表现并非衡量智能体能力的可互换指标。 LiveMACEBench 使这种区别变得可测量，将实时市场从单纯的性能排行榜转变为一个用于诊断智能体能力的测试环境。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating agent success and evaluating agent capability are different problems. Outcome metrics tell us whether an agent succeeds, but do not by themselves identify the capabilities that produced that success ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Gioacchini et al., 2024 ; Mohammadi et al., 2025 ) . This distinction becomes increasingly important as agents operate over long horizons with tools, persistent memory, explicit policies, and multi-agent architectures: access to a mechanism does not imply effective use, and effective use does not necessarily translate into better outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 评估智能体的成功与评估智能体的能力是两个不同的问题。 结果指标能告诉我们智能体是否成功，但本身无法确定实现这一成功的具体能力（Ma et al., 2024；Gioacchini et al., 2024；Mohammadi et al., 2025）。 随着智能体在长期任务中运用工具、持久记忆、显式策略和多智能体架构，这种区分变得愈发重要：拥有某种机制并不意味着能有效利用它，而有效利用也不一定能带来更好的结果。

sents.zh: 评估智能体的成功与评估智能体的能力是两个不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: The attribution problem becomes harder when the environment itself evolves. Recent agent benchmarks have begun moving beyond static tasks toward long-horizon and dynamic interaction ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Froger et al., 2026 ) . External conditions may change independently of the agent while consequences of earlier actions persist. Observed performance can therefore reflect not only the agent and its available mechanisms, but also accumulated state, environmental variation, and their interaction. Evaluating capability in such settings requires examining the process that produces an outcome, not only the outcome itself.
paragraphs.zh: 当环境本身发生演变时，归因问题会变得更加困难。 近期的智能体基准测试已开始超越静态任务，转向长期动态交互（Liu et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2024；Jimenez et al., 2024；Froger et al., 2026）。 外部条件可能独立于智能体而发生变化，而早期行动的后果却会持续存在。 因此，观察到的表现不仅可能反映智能体及其可用机制，还可能反映累积状态、环境变化以及它们之间的相互作用。 在此类情境中评估能力，需要考察产生结果的过程，而不仅仅是结果本身。

paragraphs.en: Live financial markets provide a natural testbed for this problem with prices and information continuously evolving under external forces. Recent benchmarks have leveraged this setting to evaluate agents in live or real-time markets ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Nof1, 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . We take a complementary perspective: rather than focusing primarily on trading outcomes, we use the evolving interaction itself to diagnose agent capability. Changing market conditions continually elicit information gathering, experience reuse, constraint following, and coordination, making these behaviors observable throughout the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 实时金融市场为这一问题提供了一个天然的测试环境，因为价格和信息在外部力量的作用下持续演变。 近期的基准研究利用这一环境，对智能体在实时或即时市场中的表现进行了评估（Fan et al., 2025；Nof1, 2025；Qian et al., 2026）。 我们采取一种互补的视角：与其主要关注交易结果，不如利用不断演变的互动过程本身来诊断智能体的能力。 不断变化的市场条件持续引发信息收集、经验复用、规则遵循和协同配合，使得这些行为在整个过程中都可被观察到。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LiveMACEBench , a process-aware benchmark for evaluating persistent LLM agents in naturally evolving environments. Five frontier LLMs interact with live cryptocurrency and U.S. equity markets along continuous paper-trading trajectories. On a common ReAct scaffold, we construct matched Base , Tool Use , Persistent Memory , Rule Following , and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. Complete decision traces record observations, reasoning, mechanism interactions, and actions throughout each trajectory. LiveMACEBench evaluates agents through three complementary signals: task outcomes, which measure what an agent achieves; controlled mechanism effects, which measure what changes when a mechanism is introduced; and process diagnostics, which characterize whether and how that mechanism is used. This design separates three quantities that outcome-only evaluation conflates: access to an agentic mechanism, effective use of that mechanism, and realized task benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LiveMACEBench，这是一个面向持续演进环境的、关注流程的基准测试，用于评估持久性 LLM 智能体。 五种前沿 LLM 沿着连续的模拟交易轨迹，与实时加密货币市场和美国股票市场进行交互。 在一个通用的 ReAct 框架上，我们构建了匹配的“基础操作”“工具使用”“持久记忆”“规则遵循”和“多智能体协作”等配置。 完整的决策轨迹记录了每个轨迹中观察到的信息、推理过程、机制交互以及执行的动作。 LiveMACEBench 通过三种互补的信号来评估智能体：任务结果（衡量智能体实现了什么）、受控的机制效应（衡量引入某种机制后发生了什么变化），以及流程诊断（描述该机制是否被使用以及如何使用）。 这种设计区分了仅依赖结果评估时会混淆的三个要素：对智能体机制的访问权限、对该机制的有效利用，以及最终实现的任务收益。

sents.en: LiveMACEBench evaluates agents through three complementary signals: task outcomes, which measure what an agent achieves; controlled mechanism effects, which measure what changes when a mechanism is introduced; and process diagnostics, which characterize whether and how that mechanism is used.
sents.zh: LiveMACEBench 通过三种互补的信号来评估智能体：任务结果（衡量智能体实现了什么）、受控的机制效应（衡量引入某种机制后发生了什么变化），以及流程诊断（描述该机制是否被使用以及如何使用）。

sents.zh: 这种设计区分了仅依赖结果评估时会混淆的三个要素：对智能体机制的访问权限、对该机制的有效利用，以及最终实现的任务收益。

paragraphs.en: Across five frontier LLMs evaluated for 30 days, we observe a pronounced outcome–capability gap : return rankings fluctuate substantially over time and often diverge from capability-specific measurements, while similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Process diagnostics further reveal distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, including redundant tool interactions, ineffective memory reuse, unauditable rule execution, and limited evidence integration in multi-agent systems. Together, these results show that mechanism availability, mechanism utilization, and realized performance capture distinct dimensions of agent evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在对五种前沿大型语言模型进行为期 30 天的评估中，我们观察到一个显著的成果–能力差距：回报排名会随时间大幅波动，并且常常偏离针对特定能力的测量结果，而相似的成果可能源于机制使用模式的显著差异。 流程诊断进一步揭示了不同能力之间的独特瓶颈，包括冗余的工具交互、低效的记忆复用、无法审计的规则执行，以及多智能体系统中证据整合的局限性。 综合来看，这些结果表明，机制可用性、机制利用率和实际表现分别反映了智能体评估的不同维度。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold:(1) Process-aware evaluation of agent capability. We formulate agent evaluation around the distinction between realized outcomes and the mechanisms that produce them, combining task performance, controlled mechanism effects, and trace-derived diagnostics; (2) Controlled diagnosis of agentic mechanisms. LiveMACEBench evaluates Tool Use , Persistent Memory , Rule Following , and Multi-Agent Collaboration under matched backbones, environments, and interaction protocols, enabling capability differences and failure modes to be localized rather than inferred from aggregate performance. (3) A naturally evolving testbed for persistent evaluation. We instantiate this framework in live financial markets, where external conditions evolve continuously and agent actions have persistent consequences, enabling capability evaluation along open-ended trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 对智能体能力的流程感知式评估。 我们将智能体评估构建在已实现结果与产生这些结果的机制之间的区分之上，结合任务表现、受控的机制效应以及从轨迹中得出的诊断信息；(2) 对智能体机制的受控诊断。 LiveMACEBench 在匹配的骨干模型、环境和交互协议下，评估工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循和多智能体协作能力，从而能够定位能力差异和失效模式，而非仅从整体表现中推断。 (3) 一个自然演化的持续评估测试平台。 我们在实时金融市场实例化了这一框架，在此环境中，外部条件持续演变，而智能体的行为会产生持久影响，从而支持沿着开放轨迹进行的能力评估。

paragraphs.en: LiveMACEBench uses live financial markets as an evolving environment for long-horizon agent evaluation. Its design has two components: a shared live-market interaction protocol that exposes all agents to the same evolving conditions, and controlled agent variants that introduce tool use, memory, policy guidance, or multi-agent collaboration on top of a common ReAct scaffold. We evaluate each variant using both task outcomes and mechanism-specific process diagnostics. Figure 1 gives an overview.
paragraphs.zh: LiveMACEBench 将实时金融市场用作一个不断演化的环境，用于对智能体进行长期评估。 其设计包含两个部分：一个共享的实时市场交互协议，使所有智能体都面临相同的演化条件；以及受控的智能体变体，在通用的 ReAct 框架之上引入了工具使用、记忆、策略引导或多智能体协作等功能。 我们通过任务结果和机制特定的过程诊断来评估每种变体。 图 1 提供了整体概览。

paragraphs.en: LiveMACEBench evaluates agents in live cryptocurrency and U.S. equity markets through a persistent paper-trading environment. Market conditions evolve continuously and independently of the agents as new prices and external information arrive, while each agent maintains its own non-resettable account state. Actions therefore have persistent consequences: a trade changes the portfolio exposed to all subsequent market movements and decisions. Although an experiment is observed over a finite evaluation window, the underlying interaction has no task-defined terminal state.
paragraphs.zh: LiveMACEBench 通过一个持续运行的模拟交易环境，评估智能体在实时加密货币和美国股票市场中的表现。 随着新价格和外部信息的到来，市场状况会持续演变且独立于智能体，而每个智能体都会维持自身不可重置的账户状态。 因此，操作会产生持续的影响：一笔交易会改变投资组合，并影响其后续所有市场波动和决策。 尽管实验是在有限的评估窗口期内进行的，但其底层的交互过程并没有任务定义的最终终止状态。

sents.en: LiveMACEBench evaluates agents in live cryptocurrency and U.S. equity markets through a persistent paper-trading environment.
sents.zh: LiveMACEBench 通过一个持续运行的模拟交易环境，评估智能体在实时加密货币和美国股票市场中的表现。

sents.en: Market conditions evolve continuously and independently of the agents as new prices and external information arrive, while each agent maintains its own non-resettable account state.
sents.zh: 随着新价格和外部信息的到来，市场状况会持续演变且独立于智能体，而每个智能体都会维持自身不可重置的账户状态。

sents.en: Actions therefore have persistent consequences: a trade changes the portfolio exposed to all subsequent market movements and decisions.
sents.zh: 因此，操作会产生持续的影响：一笔交易会改变投资组合，并影响其后续所有市场波动和决策。

sents.en: Although an experiment is observed over a finite evaluation window, the underlying interaction has no task-defined terminal state.
sents.zh: 尽管实验是在有限的评估窗口期内进行的，但其底层的交互过程并没有任务定义的最终终止状态。

paragraphs.en: We organize agent interaction around decision rounds scheduled every four hours on a shared decision-time grid. At each point on the grid, every agent begins a new decision round . A decision round is one complete invocation of the agent: within the round, the agent may perform multiple reasoning and tool-interaction steps, gather evidence, and issue zero or more trading actions before terminating. Positions and account state produced by one round are carried into later rounds. We refer to the complete sequence of model responses, tool calls, tool outputs, and actions within a round as its decision trace . Because markets continue to evolve between four-hour decision rounds , we evaluate trading outcomes (e.g., returns ) at finer time intervals using account-equity checkpoints; see Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体互动组织在共享决策时间网格上每四小时安排一次的决策回合中。 在网格上的每个时间点，每个智能体都会开始一个新的决策回合。 一个决策回合是智能体的完整一次调用：在该回合内，智能体可以执行多次推理和工具交互步骤、收集证据，并在终止前发出零次或多次交易动作。 一个回合产生的状态和账户状态会延续到后续回合中。 我们将一个回合内模型响应、工具调用、工具输出和动作的完整序列称为其决策轨迹。 由于市场在每四小时的决策回合之间持续演变，我们使用账户权益检查点在更细的时间间隔上评估交易结果（例如，收益率）；参见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: LiveMACEBench evaluates five controlled agent configurations: a Base configuration and four capability-specific variants targeting Tool Use , Persistent Memory , Rule Following , and Multi-Agent Collaboration . The Base configuration follows a common ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) interaction scaffold, while each variant introduces a targeted mechanism on top of the shared environment and evaluation protocol. The design supports both matched comparisons between configurations under the same backbone and comparisons across backbones under a common configuration. Detailed runtime implementations are provided in Appendix B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: LiveMACEBench 评估了五种受控的智能体配置：一种基础配置（Base）和四种针对特定能力的变体，分别聚焦于工具使用（Tool Use）、持久记忆（Persistent Memory）、规则遵循（Rule Following）和多智能体协作（Multi-Agent Collaboration）。 基础配置遵循常见的 ReAct（Yao 等人，2023）交互框架，而每种变体则在共享环境与评估协议之上引入了一种针对性机制。 该设计既支持在相同主干架构下对配置进行匹配比较，也支持在统一配置下跨不同主干架构进行比较。 详细的运行时实现见附录 B.3。

sents.en: LiveMACEBench evaluates five controlled agent configurations: a Base configuration and four capability-specific variants targeting Tool Use , Persistent Memory , Rule Following , and Multi-Agent Collaboration .
sents.zh: LiveMACEBench 评估了五种受控的智能体配置：一种基础配置（Base）和四种针对特定能力的变体，分别聚焦于工具使用（Tool Use）、持久记忆（Persistent Memory）、规则遵循（Rule Following）和多智能体协作（Multi-Agent Collaboration）。

sents.zh: 详细的运行时实现见附录 B.3。

paragraphs.en: Base. The reference agent follows a standard ReAct process. Within each decision round, it iteratively reasons over current market and portfolio evidence, invokes a fixed set of tools, and may execute trades before completing the round. Account state persists across subsequent rounds, providing the common interaction scaffold for the other configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 基础。 参考智能体遵循标准的 ReAct 流程。 在每个决策回合中，它会迭代地基于当前市场和投资组合的证据进行推理，调用一组固定的工具，并可能在完成该回合前执行交易。 账户状态会在后续回合中持续存在，为其他配置提供共同的交互框架。

sents.en: Base.
sents.zh: 基础。

sents.en: The reference agent follows a standard ReAct process.
sents.zh: 参考智能体遵循标准的 ReAct 流程。

sents.en: Within each decision round, it iteratively reasons over current market and portfolio evidence, invokes a fixed set of tools, and may execute trades before completing the round.
sents.zh: 在每个决策回合中，它会迭代地基于当前市场和投资组合的证据进行推理，调用一组固定的工具，并可能在完成该回合前执行交易。

sents.en: Account state persists across subsequent rounds, providing the common interaction scaffold for the other configurations.
sents.zh: 账户状态会在后续回合中持续存在，为其他配置提供共同的交互框架。

paragraphs.en: Tool use. This configuration extends the Base agent with a large heterogeneous tool space accessed through dynamic routing. Within a decision round, the agent retrieves tools according to its current information needs and incorporates their outputs into subsequent reasoning and actions. It is designed to evaluate tool discovery, invocation, and evidence use beyond a fixed tool set.
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用。 此配置在基础智能体的基础上扩展了一个大型异构工具空间，并通过动态路由进行访问。 在一个决策回合中，智能体会根据当前的信息需求获取工具，并将其输出整合到后续的推理和行动中。 该设计旨在评估在固定工具集之外发现、调用和使用证据的能力。

sents.en: Tool use.
sents.zh: 工具使用。

sents.en: This configuration extends the Base agent with a large heterogeneous tool space accessed through dynamic routing.
sents.zh: 此配置在基础智能体的基础上扩展了一个大型异构工具空间，并通过动态路由进行访问。

sents.en: Within a decision round, the agent retrieves tools according to its current information needs and incorporates their outputs into subsequent reasoning and actions.
sents.zh: 在一个决策回合中，智能体会根据当前的信息需求获取工具，并将其输出整合到后续的推理和行动中。

sents.en: It is designed to evaluate tool discovery, invocation, and evidence use beyond a fixed tool set.
sents.zh: 该设计旨在评估在固定工具集之外发现、调用和使用证据的能力。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory. This configuration adds persistent memory across decision rounds. The agent can retrieve reusable experience accumulated earlier in the trajectory and store new experience for later rounds, enabling evaluation of how models construct, retrieve, and apply experience over long-horizon interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 持久记忆。 此配置在多个决策回合中增加了持久记忆功能。 智能体可以检索轨迹早期积累的可重复使用的经验，并存储新经验供后续回合使用，从而能够评估模型如何在长期互动中构建、检索和应用经验。

sents.en: Persistent memory.
sents.zh: 持久记忆。

sents.en: This configuration adds persistent memory across decision rounds.
sents.zh: 此配置在多个决策回合中增加了持久记忆功能。

sents.en: The agent can retrieve reusable experience accumulated earlier in the trajectory and store new experience for later rounds, enabling evaluation of how models construct, retrieve, and apply experience over long-horizon interaction.
sents.zh: 智能体可以检索轨迹早期积累的可重复使用的经验，并存储新经验供后续回合使用，从而能够评估模型如何在长期互动中构建、检索和应用经验。

paragraphs.en: Rule following. This configuration introduces a hierarchical trading rule that separates hard trading constraints (R0 and R1) from lower-priority trading preferences (R2), with explicit priority R ​ 0 > R ​ 1 > R ​ 2 R0>R1>R2 . Within each decision round, the agent is instructed to keep its actions within the hard constraints, account for soft preferences, and resolve conflicts according to the hierarchy. It must also explicitly state which rules it checked, how it assessed their status, and how any conflicts affected the final decision, making both executed compliance and demonstrated understanding of the rules observable for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 规则遵循。 此配置引入了一种分层交易规则，将硬性交易约束（R0 和 R1）与优先级较低的交易偏好（R2）区分开来，其明确优先级为 R0>R1>R2。 在每个决策回合中，智能体被要求将其行动限制在硬性约束范围内，考虑软性偏好，并根据层级结构解决冲突。 它还必须明确说明检查了哪些规则、如何评估这些规则的状态，以及任何冲突如何影响最终决策，从而使得执行中的合规性和对规则的理解都能被观察到以进行评估。

sents.en: Rule following.
sents.zh: 规则遵循。

sents.en: This configuration introduces a hierarchical trading rule that separates hard trading constraints (R0 and R1) from lower-priority trading preferences (R2), with explicit priority R ​ 0 > R ​ 1 > R ​ 2 R0>R1>R2 .
sents.zh: 此配置引入了一种分层交易规则，将硬性交易约束（R0 和 R1）与优先级较低的交易偏好（R2）区分开来，其明确优先级为 R0>R1>R2。

sents.en: Within each decision round, the agent is instructed to keep its actions within the hard constraints, account for soft preferences, and resolve conflicts according to the hierarchy.
sents.zh: 在每个决策回合中，智能体被要求将其行动限制在硬性约束范围内，考虑软性偏好，并根据层级结构解决冲突。

sents.en: It must also explicitly state which rules it checked, how it assessed their status, and how any conflicts affected the final decision, making both executed compliance and demonstrated understanding of the rules observable for evaluation.
sents.zh: 它还必须明确说明检查了哪些规则、如何评估这些规则的状态，以及任何冲突如何影响最终决策，从而使得执行中的合规性和对规则的理解都能被观察到以进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent collaboration. This configuration replaces the single-agent reasoning process within each decision round with a manager-led hierarchy of specialized agents followed by a separate execution stage. The manager selectively delegates information needs, integrates source-attributed specialist evidence, and forms the final plan, enabling collaboration to be evaluated through observable role participation and evidence integration.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体协作。 此配置将每个决策轮次中的单智能体推理过程替换为一种由管理者主导的层级结构：先由专业智能体执行任务，随后进入独立的执行阶段。 管理者会选择性地分配信息需求、整合带有来源标注的专业证据，并制定最终计划，从而使得协作能够通过可观察的角色参与和证据整合过程得到评估。

sents.en: Multi-agent collaboration.
sents.zh: 多智能体协作。

sents.en: This configuration replaces the single-agent reasoning process within each decision round with a manager-led hierarchy of specialized agents followed by a separate execution stage.
sents.zh: 此配置将每个决策轮次中的单智能体推理过程替换为一种由管理者主导的层级结构：先由专业智能体执行任务，随后进入独立的执行阶段。

sents.en: The manager selectively delegates information needs, integrates source-attributed specialist evidence, and forms the final plan, enabling collaboration to be evaluated through observable role participation and evidence integration.
sents.zh: 管理者会选择性地分配信息需求、整合带有来源标注的专业证据，并制定最终计划，从而使得协作能够通过可观察的角色参与和证据整合过程得到评估。

paragraphs.en: Cumulative return provides a shared task-level measure of realized performance across all agent configurations. To characterize the capabilities introduced by different agent configurations, we additionally evaluate capability-specific dimensions derived from decision trajectories and records. We summarize the dimensions used in the main evaluation below; complete definition and scoring procedures are provided in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 累计回报为所有智能体配置下的实际表现提供了一个统一的、任务层面的衡量指标。 为了描述不同智能体配置所引入的能力，我们还进一步评估了从决策轨迹和记录中推导出的特定能力维度。 我们在下文总结了主要评估中使用的维度；完整的定义和评分流程见附录 B.4。

sents.en: Cumulative return provides a shared task-level measure of realized performance across all agent configurations.
sents.zh: 累计回报为所有智能体配置下的实际表现提供了一个统一的、任务层面的衡量指标。

sents.en: To characterize the capabilities introduced by different agent configurations, we additionally evaluate capability-specific dimensions derived from decision trajectories and records.
sents.zh: 为了描述不同智能体配置所引入的能力，我们还进一步评估了从决策轨迹和记录中推导出的特定能力维度。

sents.en: We summarize the dimensions used in the main evaluation below; complete definition and scoring procedures are provided in Appendix B.4 .
sents.zh: 我们在下文总结了主要评估中使用的维度；完整的定义和评分流程见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: Tool use. We evaluate tool use through both evidence acquisition and execution reliability. LLM-as-a-judge scores Tool Relevance (TR) , Invocation Efficiency (IE) , Information Coverage (IC) , and Evidence Faithfulness (EF) , measuring whether the agent selects useful tools, invokes them efficiently, gathers sufficient evidence, and grounds its reasoning in tool outputs. We further compute three objective metrics from execution traces: Routing Quality (RQ) , Valid Call Rate (VCR) , and Hallucination-Free Rate (HFR) from execution traces, capturing tool discovery and invocation reliability. We combine the judge-based and objective metrics into a compact Tool Call Score (TCS) for the overall capability profile. Full definitions and judge rubrics are given in Appendix B.4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用。 我们通过证据获取和执行可靠性两个方面来评估工具使用情况。 LLM-裁判模型会评分工具相关性（TR）、调用效率（IE）、信息覆盖度（IC）和证据忠实度（EF），用于衡量智能体是否选择了有用的工具、高效地调用了它们、收集了足够的证据，并基于工具输出进行推理。 我们还从执行轨迹中计算三个客观指标：路由质量（RQ）、有效调用率（VCR）和无幻觉率（HFR），这些指标反映了工具发现与调用的可靠性。 我们将基于裁判的指标和客观指标结合为一个简洁的工具调用得分（TCS），以反映整体能力概况。 完整定义和裁判评分标准见附录 B.4.1。

sents.en: Tool use.
sents.zh: 工具使用。

sents.en: We evaluate tool use through both evidence acquisition and execution reliability.
sents.zh: 我们通过证据获取和执行可靠性两个方面来评估工具使用情况。

sents.en: LLM-as-a-judge scores Tool Relevance (TR) , Invocation Efficiency (IE) , Information Coverage (IC) , and Evidence Faithfulness (EF) , measuring whether the agent selects useful tools, invokes them efficiently, gathers sufficient evidence, and grounds its reasoning in tool outputs.
sents.zh: LLM-裁判模型会评分工具相关性（TR）、调用效率（IE）、信息覆盖度（IC）和证据忠实度（EF），用于衡量智能体是否选择了有用的工具、高效地调用了它们、收集了足够的证据，并基于工具输出进行推理。

sents.en: We further compute three objective metrics from execution traces: Routing Quality (RQ) , Valid Call Rate (VCR) , and Hallucination-Free Rate (HFR) from execution traces, capturing tool discovery and invocation reliability.
sents.zh: 我们还从执行轨迹中计算三个客观指标：路由质量（RQ）、有效调用率（VCR）和无幻觉率（HFR），这些指标反映了工具发现与调用的可靠性。

sents.en: We combine the judge-based and objective metrics into a compact Tool Call Score (TCS) for the overall capability profile.
sents.zh: 我们将基于裁判的指标和客观指标结合为一个简洁的工具调用得分（TCS），以反映整体能力概况。

sents.en: Full definitions and judge rubrics are given in Appendix B.4.1 .
sents.zh: 完整定义和裁判评分标准见附录 B.4.1。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory. We evaluate persistent memory from experience construction and use to its downstream effect. Using LLM-as-a-Judge , Memory Content Quality (MCQ) measures the generalizability, information density, and diversity contribution of stored experience, while Memory Usage Quality (MUQ) measures timely retrieval and subsequent adoption in reasoning or action. One intended role of persistent memory is to reuse prior experience to avoid repeating high-risk decisions and improve long-horizon risk control. We therefore use two objective metrics to measure this downstream effect relative to the matched memory-free configuration: Change in Maximum Drawdown ( Δ ​ MDD \Delta\mathrm{MDD} ) and Change in Tail Loss ( Δ ​ TL \Delta\mathrm{TL} ) , and normalize both across backbones for the Memory Score. We combine these four dimensions into an equal-weight Memory Score (MS) as a compact summary of memory capability. Full evaluation procedures are provided in Appendix B.4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 持久记忆。 我们从经验构建与使用及其下游影响三个层面评估持久记忆。 通过“大语言模型作为评判者”（LLM-as-a-Judge）方法，记忆内容质量（MCQ）衡量所存储经验的泛化能力、信息密度以及对多样性的贡献，而记忆使用质量（MUQ）则衡量其在推理或行动中的及时检索与后续应用。 持久记忆的一项预期作用是利用过往经验，避免重复高风险决策，并提升长期风险控制能力。 因此，我们采用两项客观指标来衡量这一下游影响相对于无记忆基准配置的变化：最大回撤变化量（Δ​MDD）和尾部损失变化量（Δ​TL），并对两者进行跨基础模型的归一化处理，以生成记忆得分。 我们将这四个维度结合为一个等权重的记忆得分（MS），作为记忆能力的简洁总结。 完整的评估流程详见附录 B.4.2。

sents.en: Persistent memory.
sents.zh: 持久记忆。

sents.en: We evaluate persistent memory from experience construction and use to its downstream effect.
sents.zh: 我们从经验构建与使用及其下游影响三个层面评估持久记忆。

sents.en: One intended role of persistent memory is to reuse prior experience to avoid repeating high-risk decisions and improve long-horizon risk control.
sents.zh: 持久记忆的一项预期作用是利用过往经验，避免重复高风险决策，并提升长期风险控制能力。

sents.en: We therefore use two objective metrics to measure this downstream effect relative to the matched memory-free configuration: Change in Maximum Drawdown ( Δ ​ MDD \Delta\mathrm{MDD} ) and Change in Tail Loss ( Δ ​ TL \Delta\mathrm{TL} ) , and normalize both across backbones for the Memory Score.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用两项客观指标来衡量这一下游影响相对于无记忆基准配置的变化：最大回撤变化量（Δ​MDD）和尾部损失变化量（Δ​TL），并对两者进行跨基础模型的归一化处理，以生成记忆得分。

sents.en: We combine these four dimensions into an equal-weight Memory Score (MS) as a compact summary of memory capability.
sents.zh: 我们将这四个维度结合为一个等权重的记忆得分（MS），作为记忆能力的简洁总结。

sents.en: Full evaluation procedures are provided in Appendix B.4.2 .
sents.zh: 完整的评估流程详见附录 B.4.2。

paragraphs.en: Rule following. Rule following asks two complementary questions: whether the agent actually complies with the rules in execution, and whether it correctly understands and explains them in reasoning. A programmatic checker evaluates each decision against the applicable R0–R1 hard constraints and lower-priority R2 soft preferences, yielding two objective metrics : Hard-rule Pass Rate (HPR) and Soft-rule Satisfaction (SRS) . We combine these dimensions into a Rule Satisfaction Score (RSS) , with hard-rule compliance acting as a gate on soft-rule satisfaction. Beyond the executed actions, LLM-as-a-Judge further considers the agent’s reasoning and compliance rationale, evaluating Rule Coverage (RC) for correct identification of applicable rules and Conflict Handling (CH) for hierarchy-aware recognition and resolution of rule conflicts. Their normalized average yields the Rule Auditability Score (RAS) . Details are provided in Appendix B.4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 规则遵循。 规则遵循涉及两个互补的问题：智能体在执行时是否真正遵守规则，以及它在推理过程中是否正确理解并解释这些规则。 程序化检查器会将每个决策与适用的 R0–R1 硬性约束以及优先级较低的 R2 软性偏好进行比对，从而得出两个客观指标：硬性规则通过率（HPR）和软性规则满足度（SRS）。 我们将这些维度整合为规则满足度得分（RSS），其中对硬性规则的遵守情况作为软性规则满足度的前提条件。 除了已执行的动作外，“大语言模型作为裁判”机制还会进一步考察智能体的推理过程与合规理由，评估其对适用规则的正确识别能力（规则覆盖度，RC）以及对规则冲突的层级化识别与解决能力（冲突处理，CH）。 这些指标经过归一化处理后得到的平均值即为规则可审计性得分（RAS）。 详细信息请参见附录 B.4.3。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent collaboration. We evaluate observable collaboration through two objective metrics : Role Diversity (RD) measures the diversity of agent role participation while penalizing workflows dominated by a single role. Evidence Integration (EI) measures whether evidence produced by different agents is incorporated into the manager’s final decision through cross-agent coverage and integration. We summarize these dimensions using the Observable Collaboration Score (OCS) , their equal-weight average. The event extraction and scoring procedures are specified in Appendix B.4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体协作。 我们通过两个客观指标来评估可观测的协作：角色多样性（RD）衡量智能体角色参与的多样性，同时会对由单一角色主导的工作流程进行惩罚。 证据整合（EI）衡量不同智能体生成的证据是否通过跨智能体的覆盖与整合被纳入管理者的最终决策中。 我们使用可观测协作得分（OCS），即这些指标的等权平均值，来概括这些维度。 事件提取和评分流程详见附录 B.4.4。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate five frontier LLMs—GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V3.2 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) , Gemini-3.1-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Grok-4.20 ( xAI, 2026 ) , and Qwen3-Max ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) .—over an approximately 30-day live paper-trading period from April 13 to May 13, 2026. The evaluation covers six cryptocurrencies and seventeen U.S. equities, with the complete tradable universe provided in Appendix B.2 . U.S. equity market data are sourced from Alpaca’s consolidated Securities Information Processor (SIP) feed ( Alpaca, 2026 ) , while cryptocurrency market data are sourced from Hyperliquid ( Hyperliquid, 2026 ) . A summary of market conditions over the evaluation window is provided in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 2026 年 4 月 13 日至 5 月 13 日为期约 30 天的实时纸面交易期间，对五款前沿大型语言模型（LLM）进行了评估——GPT-5.4（OpenAI，2026）、DeepSeek-V3.2（DeepSeek-AI，2025）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（Google DeepMind，2026）、Grok-4.20（xAI，2026）以及 Qwen3-Max（Alibaba Cloud，2026）。 此次评估涵盖六种加密货币和十七种美国股票，完整的可交易资产范围见附录 B.2。 美国股票市场数据来自 Alpaca 的整合证券信息处理器（SIP）数据流（Alpaca，2026），而加密货币市场数据则来自 Hyperliquid（Hyperliquid，2026）。 评估期间市场状况的摘要见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: Realized return alone does not characterize an agent’s capabilities. It is the final outcome of a closed-loop agent–market interaction, jointly shaped by evolving market conditions and multiple aspects of agent behavior. Figure 2 (a) and Appendix Figure 13 make this entanglement visible: as the evaluation horizon expands, cumulative-return rankings fluctuate substantially, with 21, 19, 19, and 29 pairwise reversals under the tool use, memory, rule following, and collaboration configurations, respectively. Cumulative return is therefore meaningful as a realized outcome, but difficult to attribute to any specific agent capability.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭已实现的回报无法全面反映智能体的能力。 它是智能体与市场之间闭环互动的最终结果，由不断变化的市场条件以及智能体行为的多个方面共同塑造。 图 2(a) 和附录图 13 揭示了这种相互交织的关系：随着评估时间范围扩大，累计回报排名会出现显著波动，在工具使用、记忆、规则遵循和协作这四种配置下，分别出现了 21、19、19 和 29 次两两反转。 因此，累计回报作为一种已实现的结果具有意义，但很难将其归因于任何特定的智能体能力。

sents.zh: 仅凭已实现的回报无法全面反映智能体的能力。

paragraphs.en: Capability-specific metrics provide a more temporally consistent and differentiated view. Under the same evaluation protocol, the corresponding capability rankings exhibit only 0, 5, 8, and 2 reversals, respectively. Figure 2 (b) further reveals distinct capability profiles rather than a universally dominant model: GPT-5.4 leads tool use, Grok-4.20 memory utilization, Gemini-3.1-Pro rule following, and DeepSeek-V3.2 collaboration. These capability leaders can also differ from return leaders—for example, Grok-4.20 achieves the highest return in the tool-use configuration despite the lowest Tool Call Score (TCS) , while DeepSeek-V3.2 leads rule-condition returns but Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves the highest rule satisfaction. Capability-specific evaluation thus exposes both temporally consistent comparisons and heterogeneous agent strengths that a scalar return measure obscures.
paragraphs.zh: 特定能力指标提供了在时间上更一致且更具差异性的视角。 在同一评估协议下，相应能力的排名仅出现 0、5、8 和 2 次反转。 图 2(b) 进一步揭示了各自独特的能力特征，而非存在一个普遍占优的模型：GPT-5.4 在工具使用方面领先，Grok-4.20 在内存利用方面领先，Gemini-3.1-Pro 在规则遵循方面领先，而 DeepSeek-V3.2 在协作方面领先。 这些能力领导者也可能与回报领导者不同——例如，尽管 Tool Call Score (TCS) 最低，Grok-4.20 在工具使用配置中实现了最高的回报；而 DeepSeek-V3.2 在规则约束下的回报中领先，但 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的规则满足度最高。 因此，特定能力的评估既揭示了时间上一致的比较结果，也暴露了标量回报指标所掩盖的智能体之间的异质性优势。

paragraphs.en: These findings motivate using live markets as diagnostic environments, not only as leaderboard environments. An evolving market continuously presents new situations that elicit tool use, memory, rule following, and collaboration, while persistent state carries the consequences of earlier decisions into future ones. LiveMACEBench uses this interaction process as diagnostic evidence: cumulative return summarizes a realized outcome of the full agent–market interaction, whereas capability-specific metrics characterize how the agent operates throughout that interaction. The live market therefore serves not only to rank outcomes, but also to expose and diagnose the capabilities that produce them.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现促使我们将实时市场用作诊断环境，而不仅仅是排行榜环境。 不断演变的市场持续呈现新的情境，从而引发工具使用、记忆运用、规则遵循和协作行为，同时持续存在的状态会将早期决策的后果带入后续决策中。 LiveMACEBench 将这一互动过程作为诊断依据：累积回报总结了智能体与市场完整互动的实际结果，而特定能力指标则描述了智能体在整个互动过程中的运作方式。 因此，实时市场不仅用于对结果进行排名，还能揭示并诊断出产生这些结果的能力。

paragraphs.en: High information coverage masks inefficient tool-use trajectories. All four models eventually gather sufficient evidence, with Information Coverage (IC) above 0.8 in every case (0.809–0.911). Yet Invocation Efficiency (IE) is consistently the weakest judge-rated dimension (0.581–0.731; Figure 3 ). This shared gap suggests that information sufficiency is easier to achieve than economical tool use: agents can compensate for inefficient or redundant interactions by continuing to acquire evidence until coverage becomes adequate. Qwen3-Max illustrates the strongest balance among the judge-rated dimensions, achieving the highest IE (0.731) and judge mean (0.855), while GPT-5.4 attains slightly higher Tool Relevance (0.899 vs. 0.896) and IC (0.911 vs. 0.901). Thus, high coverage alone can conceal substantial differences in how efficiently agents arrive at sufficient evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 高信息覆盖度会掩盖低效的工具使用路径。 所有四个模型最终都收集了足够的证据，且信息覆盖度（IC）在所有情况下均高于 0.8（0.809–0.911）。 然而，调用效率（IE）始终是评委评分中最弱的维度（0.581–0.731；图 3）。 这一共同存在的差距表明，实现信息充分性比实现经济高效地使用道具更容易：智能体可以通过持续获取证据，直到覆盖度足够，来弥补低效或冗余的交互。 Qwen3-Max 在评委评分的各个维度中展现了最强的平衡性，实现了最高的 IE（0.731）和评委平均分（0.855），而 GPT-5.4 的工具相关性（0.899 vs. 0.896）和信息覆盖度（0.911 vs. 0.901）则略高。 因此，仅凭高覆盖度就可能掩盖智能体在高效获取足够证据方面的显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Tool discovery and tool execution constitute distinct failure modes. The objective diagnostics expose a second separation within the tool-use pipeline. Qwen3-Max has the lowest Routing Quality ( RQ =0.736) but a near-perfect Valid Call Rate ( VCR =0.978), indicating reliable execution once tools become available despite weaker tool discovery. Grok-4.20 shows the converse pattern: its RQ (0.805) exceeds both Qwen3-Max and DeepSeek-V3.2, yet its VCR falls to 0.666. GPT-5.4 is the only model that is consistently strong at both stages ( RQ =0.920; VCR =0.998). These contrasts show that tool-use errors are stage-specific: identifying a plausible tool does not guarantee that the agent can invoke it successfully, while weaker routing need not imply unreliable execution.
paragraphs.zh: 工具发现与工具执行构成了两种不同的失败模式。 目标诊断揭示了工具使用流程中的第二种分离现象。 Qwen3-Max 的路由质量（RQ =0.736）最低，但其有效调用率（VCR =0.978）接近完美，表明尽管其工具发现能力较弱，但一旦工具可用，执行过程依然可靠。 Grok-4.20 则呈现出相反的模式：其 RQ（0.805）高于 Qwen3-Max 和 DeepSeek-V3.2，但 VCR 却降至 0.666。 GPT-5.4 是唯一在两个阶段都表现稳定的模型（RQ =0.920；VCR =0.998）。 这些对比表明，工具使用错误具有阶段特异性：识别出合适的工具并不保证智能体能成功调用它，而较弱的路由能力也不必然意味着执行过程不可靠。

paragraphs.en: Persistent access does not imply persistent learning. Despite sharing the same memory mechanism, models develop markedly different memory dynamics (Memory Interaction block of Table 1 ). GPT-5.4 performs 332 retrievals but stores only one memory, whereas Gemini accumulates 93 entries; DeepSeek, Grok, and Qwen retain 41, 12, and 11, respectively. Trace analysis in appendix C.4.2 further shows that GPT repeatedly reuses a single broadly applicable rule and rarely identifies new experience worth storing, illustrating how memory construction can stagnate even under frequent retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 持续访问并不意味着持续学习。 尽管共享相同的记忆机制，模型们却发展出了明显不同的记忆动态（见表 1 的“记忆交互”部分）。 GPT-5.4 执行了 332 次检索，但仅存储了一条记忆；而 Gemini 则积累了 93 条记录；DeepSeek、Grok 和 Qwen 分别保留了 41、12 和 11 条。 附录 C.4.2 中的轨迹分析进一步表明，GPT 会重复使用一条广泛适用的单一规则，且很少识别出值得存储的新经验，这说明了即使频繁检索，记忆构建过程也可能陷入停滞。

paragraphs.en: Memory accumulation, content quality, and effective use are distinct capabilities. Memory Quality block of Table 1 exposes several cross-stage mismatches. Gemini constructs the largest store with high Memory Content Quality ( MCQ =0.938), yet has the lowest Memory Usage Quality ( MUQ =0.497). In contrast, Grok stores only 12 entries and has lower MCQ (0.760), but achieves the highest MUQ (0.855). GPT exhibits a different failure mode: its sole stored memory receives the highest MCQ (0.978), while the store itself fails to grow. These contrasting profiles show that persistent-memory capability cannot be inferred from storage volume or memory quality alone: constructing useful experience, retrieving it, and applying it to subsequent decisions are separable stages, and strength at one stage need not propagate to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆积累、内容质量和有效使用是三种不同的能力。 表 1 中的“记忆质量”部分揭示了几个跨阶段的不匹配问题。 Gemini 构建了规模最大的存储库，且记忆内容质量（MCQ =0.938）很高，但其记忆使用质量（MUQ =0.497）却最低。 相比之下，Grok 仅存储了 12 条记录，记忆内容质量（MCQ =0.760）也较低，但实现了最高的记忆使用质量（MUQ =0.855）。 GPT 表现出一种不同的失败模式：其唯一存储的记忆条目获得了最高的记忆内容质量（MCQ =0.978），但存储库本身却无法继续扩展。 这些截然不同的表现表明，仅凭存储量或记忆质量无法推断出持久记忆能力：构建有用的经验、检索这些经验以及将其应用于后续决策是相互独立的阶段，某一阶段的优势并不必然传递到下一阶段。

paragraphs.en: Memory produces consistent downside-risk improvements but heterogeneous return effects. As shown in the Downstream Effect block of Table 1 , all five memory-augmented agents reduce tail loss relative to their matched memory-free counterparts, and four of five also improve maximum drawdown and consecutive-loss streaks. The long-horizon comparison further reveals that these effects evolve over time: the w/ Mem return advantage grows in the late phase for DeepSeek and Grok, and Gemini shifts from a negative full-period differential to a positive late-period differential; GPT, whose store remains fixed at one entry, shows no corresponding improvement. Together, these results characterize persistent memory as a multi-stage, long-horizon capability whose effectiveness depends on how experience is continually constructed and translated into later decisions, rather than on accumulation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆机制能持续改善下行风险，但对回报的影响则存在异质性。 如表 1 的“下游效应”部分所示，所有五种增强记忆的智能体相较于其对应的无记忆版本均降低了尾部损失，其中四种还改善了最大回撤和连续亏损周期。 长期对比进一步表明，这些效应会随时间演变：在后期阶段，DeepSeek 和 Grok 使用记忆机制的回报优势有所扩大，而 Gemini 的全周期差异从负值转为正值；GPT 的记忆存储始终固定为单条记录，因此未表现出相应改善。 综合来看，这些结果表明持久性记忆是一种多阶段、长期能力，其有效性取决于经验如何被持续构建并转化为后续决策，而非单纯依赖经验的积累。

paragraphs.en: Execution and auditability diverge. Our rule-specific metrics reveal two separable aspects of rule-following capability. As shown in Figure 4 , DeepSeek-V3.2 achieves a strong Rule Satisfaction Score (RSS) of 0.847 0.847 but a substantially lower Rule Auditability Score (RAS) of 0.623 0.623 . In contrast, Gemini-3.1-Pro performs strongly on both dimensions, with RSS of 0.872 0.872 and RAS of 0.882 0.882 . These differences show that reliable rule following requires both policy-consistent execution and auditable rule reasoning, and that strength in one does not necessarily imply strength in the other.
paragraphs.zh: 执行能力与可审计性存在差异。 我们针对特定规则设计的指标揭示了规则遵循能力的两个可分离方面。 如图4所示，DeepSeek-V3.2 获得了较高的规则满意度得分（RSS）0.847 0.847，但规则可审计性得分（RAS）则明显较低，仅为 0.623 0.623。 相比之下，Gemini-3.1-Pro 在这两个维度上的表现均十分出色，其 RSS 为 0.872 0.872，RAS 为 0.882 0.882。 这些差异表明，可靠的规则遵循既需要与策略一致的执行能力，也需要可审计的规则推理能力；在某一方面的优势并不必然意味着另一方面的优势。

sents.zh: 执行能力与可审计性存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Trace analysis localizes key failure modes. The traces explain why execution and auditability can diverge. DeepSeek-V3.2 provides the clearest example: many of its mechanically compliant decisions contain little explicit rule checking, numerical evidence, or well-grounded conflict reasoning, and some rely on incorrect portfolio states. A recurring execution bottleneck is R1-02, the single-asset concentration limit, particularly for GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-Max. These violations often arise not from ignoring the rule, but from incorrectly combining existing exposure, incremental orders, and price movements when estimating post-trade exposure. These cases indicate that reliable rule following requires both constraint-aware execution and state-grounded rule reasoning; representative traces are provided in Appendix D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹分析可定位关键故障模式。 这些轨迹解释了执行与可审计性为何可能产生分歧。 DeepSeek-V3.2 提供了最清晰的例证：其许多机械上合规的决策中，几乎没有明确的规则检查、数值证据或基于充分依据的冲突推理，且部分决策依赖于错误的投资组合状态。 一个反复出现的执行瓶颈是 R1-02，即单一资产集中度限制，尤其对 GPT-5.4 和 Qwen3-Max 而言。 这些违规行为通常并非源于忽视规则，而是在估算交易后敞量时错误地结合了现有敞量、增量订单和价格变动。 这些案例表明，可靠的规则遵循既需要具备约束意识的执行，也需要基于状态进行规则推理；代表性轨迹已列于附录 D.3。

paragraphs.en: Realized return does not identify rule-following capability. Table 2 shows that trading performance does not recover these capability differences. DeepSeek-V3.2 and GPT-5.4 achieve nearly identical final returns ( + 5.765 % +5.765\% and + 5.738 % +5.738\% ), yet differ substantially in Hard-rule Pass Rate (HPR) ( 0.877 0.877 vs. 0.682 0.682 ) and RSS ( 0.847 0.847 vs. 0.634 0.634 ). Conversely, Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves a lower return of + 3.503 % +3.503\% while obtaining the highest HPR , RSS , and RAS among the evaluated models. Return therefore captures realized trading performance but does not substitute for direct evaluation of rule-following capability.
paragraphs.zh: 实际收益无法反映对规则的遵循能力。 表2显示，交易表现未能弥补这些能力差异。 DeepSeek-V3.2和GPT-5.4的最终收益几乎相同（+5.765% +5.765\% 和 +5.738% +5.738\%），但在硬性规则通过率（HPR）（0.877 0.877 vs. 0.682 0.682）和RSS（0.847 0.847 vs. 0.634 0.634）方面存在显著差异。 相反，Gemini-3.1-Pro的收益较低，为+3.503% +3.503\%，但在所评估的模型中获得了最高的HPR、RSS和RAS。 因此，收益虽然能反映实际交易表现，但无法替代对规则遵循能力的直接评估。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent gains are model-dependent but carry a common risk cost. Figure 5 and Table 3.2.4 show that Multi-Agent improves cumulative return over matched ReAct accounts by 2.45 2.45 , 3.72 3.72 , and 2.57 2.57 percentage points for GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, respectively, but reduces Qwen3-Max’s return by 4.39 4.39 points. The curves show that these differences accumulate throughout the period. All four models record more sharp gains, but also larger maximum drawdowns and more negative average tail losses. Multi-Agent is therefore associated with a more variable return–risk profile rather than a uniform improvement. Qwen3-Max illustrates the failure mode most clearly: six additional sharp gains are offset by a 2.85 2.85 -point increase in maximum drawdown and a lower final return.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体收益取决于具体模型，但都存在共同的風險成本。 图 5 和表 3.2.4 显示，对于 GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro，多智能体策略相较匹配的 ReAct 策略的累计回报分别提升了 2.45、3.72 和 2.57 个百分点，但 Qwen3-Max 的回报则下降了 4.39 个百分点。 曲线显示，这些差异在整个周期内持续累积。 所有四种模型都记录了更显著的收益增长，但也伴随着更大的最大回撤和更严重的负平均尾部损失。 因此，多智能体策略与回报–風險特征更具波动性相关，而非均匀的提升。 Qwen3-Max 最清晰地展示了这种失效模式：六次额外的显著收益增长被最大回撤增加 2.85 个百分点以及最终回报降低所抵消。

sents.en: Multi-agent gains are model-dependent but carry a common risk cost.
sents.zh: 多智能体收益取决于具体模型，但都存在共同的風險成本。

sents.en: Figure 5 and Table 3.2.4 show that Multi-Agent improves cumulative return over matched ReAct accounts by 2.45 2.45 , 3.72 3.72 , and 2.57 2.57 percentage points for GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, respectively, but reduces Qwen3-Max’s return by 4.39 4.39 points.
sents.zh: 图 5 和表 3.2.4 显示，对于 GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro，多智能体策略相较匹配的 ReAct 策略的累计回报分别提升了 2.45、3.72 和 2.57 个百分点，但 Qwen3-Max 的回报则下降了 4.39 个百分点。

sents.en: The curves show that these differences accumulate throughout the period.
sents.zh: 曲线显示，这些差异在整个周期内持续累积。

sents.en: All four models record more sharp gains, but also larger maximum drawdowns and more negative average tail losses.
sents.zh: 所有四种模型都记录了更显著的收益增长，但也伴随着更大的最大回撤和更严重的负平均尾部损失。

sents.en: Multi-Agent is therefore associated with a more variable return–risk profile rather than a uniform improvement.
sents.zh: 因此，多智能体策略与回报–風險特征更具波动性相关，而非均匀的提升。

sents.en: Qwen3-Max illustrates the failure mode most clearly: six additional sharp gains are offset by a 2.85 2.85 -point increase in maximum drawdown and a lower final return.
sents.zh: Qwen3-Max 最清晰地展示了这种失效模式：六次额外的显著收益增长被最大回撤增加 2.85 个百分点以及最终回报降低所抵消。

paragraphs.en: The same harness induces distinct collaboration patterns. Figure 6 shows that a shared multi-agent harness does not produce a shared collaboration pattern. Role Diversity (RD) and Evidence Integration (EI) distinguish these patterns. DeepSeek-V3.2 exhibits the most balanced behavior ( RD = 0.760, EI = 0.852). Gemini-3.1-Pro is evidence-centric: moderate RD (0.492) is paired with the highest EI (0.984). Qwen3-Max reuses substantial evidence ( EI = 0.751) but relies on a narrower role set ( RD = 0.282), while GPT-5.4 nearly collapses to a single-role workflow despite limited evidence transfer ( RD = 0.012, EI = 0.518). The presence of multiple agents therefore does not itself demonstrate substantive collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的约束机制会引发不同的协作模式。 图6显示，共享的多智能体约束机制并不会产生共享的协作模式。 角色多样性（RD）和证据整合（EI）区分了这些模式。 DeepSeek-V3.2表现出最均衡的行为（RD = 0.760，EI = 0.852）。 Gemini-3.1-Pro以证据为中心：适中的RD（0.492）与最高的EI（0.984）相结合。 Qwen3-Max重复使用了大量证据（EI = 0.751），但依赖的角色集合更狭窄（RD = 0.282），而GPT-5.4尽管证据转移有限，却几乎退化为单一角色的工作流程（RD = 0.012，EI = 0.518）。 因此，存在多个智能体本身并不能证明存在实质性的协作。

paragraphs.en: Observable collaboration and realized performance are complementary. DeepSeek-V3.2 combines the highest Observable Collaboration Score (OCS) , the mean of RD and EI , with the largest return gain, yet the remaining models break any simple monotonic relationship. GPT-5.4 improves its return despite almost no role diversity, whereas Qwen3-Max retains non-trivial evidence integration but underperforms ReAct. The return difference captures the realized effect of the configuration along the observed market trajectory, while OCS captures whether the model delegates across roles and integrates agent-produced evidence. Reporting both distinguishes realized trading performance from observable collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 可观察的协作与实现的性能是互补的。 DeepSeek-V3.2 结合了最高的可观察协作得分（OCS）——即 RD 和 EI 的平均值——以及最大的回报增益，但其余模型则打破了任何简单的单调关系。 GPT-5.4 尽管几乎没有角色多样性，其回报仍有所提升；而 Qwen3-Max 虽然保留了非微不足道的证据整合能力，但表现却不如 ReAct。 回报差异反映了配置在已观察市场轨迹上的实际效果，而 OCS 则衡量模型是否在不同角色间进行协作并整合智能体生成的证据。 同时报告这两者有助于区分实际的交易性能与可观察的协作能力。

paragraphs.en: Agent evaluation beyond task outcomes. Agent benchmarks have expanded LLM evaluation from isolated responses to multi-step interaction with tools and environments, including AgentBench, WebArena, and SWE-bench ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . Analytical benchmarks such as AgentBoard and AgentQuest further argue that final task success alone provides limited diagnostic information and introduce process- or progress-level measurements ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Gioacchini et al., 2024 ) . More recent benchmarks extend evaluation toward consequential, long-horizon, and dynamic settings, including TheAgentCompany, Odysseys, WildClawBench, SWE-Marathon, and GAIA2 ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Desai et al., 2026 ; Froger et al., 2026 ) . LiveMACEBench builds on this shift from outcome-only toward process-aware evaluation, but studies persistent trajectories in an environment whose external dynamics are not task-scripted: live markets continue to evolve independently of the agent while earlier actions alter its future state.
paragraphs.zh: 超越任务结果的智能体评估。 智能体基准测试已将大型语言模型（LLM）的评估范围从孤立响应扩展到与工具和环境的多步骤交互，包括 AgentBench、WebArena 和 SWE-bench（Liu 等，2025；Zhou 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024）。 AgentBoard 和 AgentQuest 等分析性基准测试进一步指出，仅凭最终任务成功所提供的诊断信息有限，并引入了过程或进展层面的测量指标（Ma 等，2024；Gioacchini 等，2024）。 近期推出的基准测试将评估扩展到了具有后果性、长期性和动态性的场景，包括 TheAgentCompany、Odysseys、WildClawBench、SWE-Marathon 和 GAIA2（Xu 等，2025；Jang 等，2026；Ding 等，2026；Desai 等，2026；Froger 等，2026）。 LiveMACEBench 建立在这一从仅关注结果转向关注过程的评估转变之上，但它研究的是在一个外部动态并非任务脚本所规定的环境中的持续轨迹：实时市场会独立于智能体而持续演变，而早期的行动则会改变其未来状态。

paragraphs.en: Financial agents and live-market evaluation. Financial LLM benchmarks span question answering, reasoning, forecasting, and decision making ( Islam et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , while trading systems have incorporated persistent memory, tool augmentation, and specialized multi-agent architectures ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . More closely related, InvestorBench standardizes financial decision tasks ( Li et al., 2024 ) , while Alpha Arena, Agent Market Arena, and AI-Trader evaluate agents in live or real-time markets ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Nof1, 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . Recent benchmarks additionally address memory leakage and return attribution ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , experience accumulation under delayed market feedback ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and closed-loop portfolio diagnosis ( Qu and Chen, 2026 ) . LiveMACEBench is complementary to these efforts: rather than treating trading performance as the primary object of comparison, it uses a shared live-market trajectory as a diagnostic substrate and introduces matched mechanism variants and trace-derived metrics to distinguish mechanism access, effective use, and realized benefit across tool use, persistent memory, rule following, and multi-agent collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 金融智能体与实时市场评估。 金融领域的大型语言模型基准涵盖问答、推理、预测和决策（Islam 等，2023；Xie 等，2023；Xie 等，2024），而交易系统则整合了持久记忆、工具增强以及专门的多人智能体架构（Yu 等，2023；Zhang 等，2024；Xiao 等，2024）。 更密切相关的是，InvestorBench 对金融决策任务进行了标准化（Li 等，2024），而 Alpha Arena、Agent Market Arena 和 AI-Trader 则在实时或即时市场中评估智能体（Fan 等，2025；Nof1，2025；Qian 等，2026）。 近期的基准测试还进一步解决了记忆泄漏与收益归因（Zhu 等，2026）、延迟市场反馈下的经验积累（Deng 等，2026），以及闭环投资组合诊断（Qu 和 Chen，2026）等问题。 LiveMACEBench 是对这些工作的补充：它并非将交易表现作为主要比较对象，而是采用共享的实时市场轨迹作为诊断基础，并引入匹配的机制变体与轨迹衍生指标，以区分工具使用、持久记忆、规则遵循和多人智能体协作中不同机制的访问、有效利用及实际收益。

paragraphs.en: We introduced LiveMACEBench , a process-aware benchmark for evaluating LLM agent capabilities under sustained, externally driven change. Using live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed, LiveMACEBench combines persistent, non-resettable trajectories with controlled agent configurations and trace-derived diagnostics to distinguish mechanism access, mechanism use, and realized effect. Across five frontier LLMs and approximately 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome–capability gap: realized performance varies substantially over time and does not reliably recover how effectively agents use the mechanisms available to them. Process diagnostics expose the underlying differences—memory accumulation does not guarantee effective reuse, rule execution can diverge from auditability, and multi-agent gains can occur without strong observable collaboration. These results show that similar outcomes can mask different capabilities, while access to an agentic mechanism need not translate into effective use or improved performance. More broadly, evaluating agents in evolving environments requires more than ranking outcomes: it requires measuring the mechanisms through which those outcomes arise. LiveMACEBench provides one instantiation of this principle in financial markets; extending process-aware evaluation across longer horizons, broader regimes, and other continuously evolving environments is a natural next step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LiveMACEBench，这是一个流程感知的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型智能体在持续且由外部驱动的变化环境下的能力。 LiveMACEBench 以实时金融市场作为自然演化的测试平台，将持久且不可重置的流程轨迹与受控的智能体配置及基于追踪的诊断指标相结合，从而区分机制的访问、机制的使用以及实际产生的效果。 通过对五种前沿大型语言模型进行为期约 30 天的实时评估，我们发现结果与能力之间存在显著差距：实际表现随时间推移存在较大差异，且无法可靠地反映智能体对其可用机制的有效利用程度。 流程诊断揭示了其背后的差异——记忆积累并不保证有效复用，规则执行可能与可审计性偏离，而多智能体的协同增益也可能在没有明显可观测协作的情况下出现。 这些结果表明，相似的结果可能掩盖不同的能力，而对智能体机制的访问并不必然转化为有效使用或性能提升。 更广泛地说，在动态环境中评估智能体不仅需要排名结果，还需要衡量产生这些结果的机制本身。 LiveMACEBench 在金融市场中体现了这一原则的一个具体实例；将流程感知评估扩展到更长的时间跨度、更广泛的制度环境以及其他持续演化的场景，是顺理成章的下一步。

paragraphs.en: This section provides the two LLM-as-a-Judge rubrics used to evaluate the Persistent Memory configuration: Memory Content Quality and Memory Usage Quality. These rubrics produce S content S_{\text{content}} and S usage S_{\text{usage}} , respectively. Each judge is queried in JSON mode; every dimension is rated on a 0 0 – 5 5 integer scale and linearly normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] before averaging. The reported scores are averaged over three judge models (GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking, and Qwen3-Max).
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了用于评估“持久记忆”配置的两个“大语言模型作为裁判”评分标准：记忆内容质量和记忆使用质量。 这些评分标准分别生成内容得分 S_{\text{content}} 和使用得分 S_{\text{usage}}。 每个裁判均以 JSON 模式进行查询；每个维度均按 0–5 的整数量表评分，并在求平均前线性归一化到 [0,1] 区间。 所报告的分数是对三个裁判模型（GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 和 Qwen3-Max）的平均值。

paragraphs.en: Agents make trading decisions every four hours, while market prices continue to change between decisions. To capture these changes, we evaluate trading outcomes at 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour, and 1-day intervals. We do this by recording account checkpoints at fixed time intervals. A checkpoint is simply a snapshot of how much the entire trading account is worth at that time.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体每四小时做出一次交易决策，而市场价格在两次决策之间持续变化。 为了捕捉这些变化，我们在 15 分钟、1 小时、4 小时和 1 天的时间间隔上评估交易结果。 我们通过以固定时间间隔记录账户检查点来实现这一点。 检查点本质上是在特定时刻整个交易账户价值的一个快照。

paragraphs.en: Slice Win Rate (SWR) is the fraction of one-hour intervals with a positive return. Maximum drawdown (MDD) measures the largest drop in account value from a previous high, capturing the worst decline experienced by the account. A lower MDD indicates a smaller worst-case decline. The Sharpe Ratio compares return with how much returns fluctuate; a higher Sharpe Ratio indicates more return relative to these fluctuations. The Calmar Ratio compares return with maximum drawdown; a higher Calmar Ratio indicates more return relative to the account’s worst decline. We also use the one-hour returns to compute TailLoss , which is the average return over the worst-performing 5% of one-hour intervals. Because TailLoss is expressed as a signed return, a value closer to zero (i.e., less negative) indicates smaller losses during these worst-performing intervals. We also records Rolling Volatility , which measures how much recent returns fluctuate, computed as the standard deviation of the most recent n n returns. A higher value indicates greater fluctuation.
paragraphs.zh: 单小时胜率（SWR）是指在一小时时间区间中，收益为正的区间所占的比例。 最大回撤（MDD）衡量账户价值从先前高点下跌的最大幅度，反映了账户经历的最差跌幅。 MDD 越低，表示最差情况下的跌幅越小。 夏普比率将收益与收益的波动程度进行比较；夏普比率越高，表示相对于这些波动而言的收益越高。 卡尔玛比率将收益与最大回撤进行比较；卡尔玛比率越高，表示相对于账户的最差跌幅而言的收益越高。 我们还利用单小时收益计算 TailLoss，即表现最差的 5% 单小时区间内的平均收益。 由于 TailLoss 以带符号的收益表示，因此数值越接近零（即负值越小），表明在这些表现最差的区间内损失越小。 我们还记录 Rolling Volatility，它衡量近期收益的波动程度，计算方式为最近 n 个收益的标准差。 数值越高，表示波动越大。

sents.zh: 单小时胜率（SWR）是指在一小时时间区间中，收益为正的区间所占的比例。

sents.en: We also use the one-hour returns to compute TailLoss , which is the average return over the worst-performing 5% of one-hour intervals.
sents.zh: 我们还利用单小时收益计算 TailLoss，即表现最差的 5% 单小时区间内的平均收益。

sents.en: Because TailLoss is expressed as a signed return, a value closer to zero (i.e., less negative) indicates smaller losses during these worst-performing intervals.

paragraphs.en: The platform checks account states every 30 seconds and saves a checkpoint record whenever a measurement boundary is reached. Each checkpoint for a given account, interval, and end time is written only once. The ending account value of one interval is used as the starting value of the next interval; the first interval starts from the initial account capital. If the starting account value is non-positive, the corresponding return is set to zero. Rolling volatility is set to zero when fewer than two return observations are available. The 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour, and 1-day series are maintained independently.
paragraphs.zh: 该平台每 30 秒检查一次账户状态，并在每次达到测量边界时保存一个检查点记录。 对于给定的账户、时间间隔和结束时间，每个检查点仅写入一次。 一个时间间隔的结束账户值将用作下一个时间间隔的起始值；第一个时间间隔从初始账户本金开始。 如果起始账户值为非正数，则相应的回报被设为零。 当可用的回报观测值少于两个时，滚动波动率被设为零。 15 分钟、1 小时、4 小时和 1 天的序列均独立维护。

sents.en: The platform checks account states every 30 seconds and saves a checkpoint record whenever a measurement boundary is reached.
sents.zh: 该平台每 30 秒检查一次账户状态，并在每次达到测量边界时保存一个检查点记录。

sents.en: Each checkpoint for a given account, interval, and end time is written only once.
sents.zh: 对于给定的账户、时间间隔和结束时间，每个检查点仅写入一次。

sents.en: The ending account value of one interval is used as the starting value of the next interval; the first interval starts from the initial account capital.
sents.zh: 一个时间间隔的结束账户值将用作下一个时间间隔的起始值；第一个时间间隔从初始账户本金开始。

sents.en: If the starting account value is non-positive, the corresponding return is set to zero.
sents.zh: 如果起始账户值为非正数，则相应的回报被设为零。

sents.en: Rolling volatility is set to zero when fewer than two return observations are available.
sents.zh: 当可用的回报观测值少于两个时，滚动波动率被设为零。

sents.en: The 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour, and 1-day series are maintained independently.
sents.zh: 15 分钟、1 小时、4 小时和 1 天的序列均独立维护。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation uses a fixed universe of 23 23 tradable assets across cryptocurrency and U.S. equity markets. The cryptocurrency universe consists of BTC , ETH , SOL , BNB , XRP , and DOGE . The U.S. equity universe consists of AAPL , NVDA , GOOGL , META , AMZN , TSLA , PG , JNJ , UNH , JPM , V , BA , XOM , NEE , AMT , PLD , and LIN. Agents are restricted to this universe throughout the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 本次评估使用一个固定的资产池，包含 23 种可在加密货币和美国股票市场交易的资产。 加密货币资产池包括 BTC、ETH、SOL、BNB、XRP 和 DOGE。 美国股票资产池包括 AAPL、NVDA、GOOGL、META、AMZN、TSLA、PG、JNJ、UNH、JPM、V、BA、XOM、NEE、AMT、PLD 和 LIN。 在整个评估过程中，智能体只能在该资产池内操作。

paragraphs.en: We use grid trading [ Chen et al., 2025 ] as a deterministic and reproducible active-trading baseline. Starting from the initial reference price, the strategy constructs five grid levels above and below the reference price using multiplicative 1% spacing. It allocates up to 80% of account equity to grid trading. The remaining implementation parameters are summarized in Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将网格交易 [ Chen et al., 2025 ] 用作一种确定且可复现的主动交易基准。 该策略从初始参考价格出发，通过以 1% 为乘数间隔的方式，在参考价格上下构建五个网格层级。 它将最多 80% 的账户权益分配给网格交易。 其余的实现参数总结于表 4。

sents.en: We use grid trading [ Chen et al., 2025 ] as a deterministic and reproducible active-trading baseline.
sents.zh: 我们将网格交易 [ Chen et al., 2025 ] 用作一种确定且可复现的主动交易基准。

sents.en: Starting from the initial reference price, the strategy constructs five grid levels above and below the reference price using multiplicative 1% spacing.
sents.zh: 该策略从初始参考价格出发，通过以 1% 为乘数间隔的方式，在参考价格上下构建五个网格层级。

sents.en: It allocates up to 80% of account equity to grid trading.
sents.zh: 它将最多 80% 的账户权益分配给网格交易。

sents.en: The remaining implementation parameters are summarized in Table 4 .
sents.zh: 其余的实现参数总结于表 4。

paragraphs.en: Environment variable Experimental setting Meaning GRID_LEVELS 5 Number of grid levels, with five levels above and below GRID_STEP_PCT 0.01 (1%) Relative interval between adjacent levels, using multiplicative spacing GRID_CAPITAL_USAGE 0.8 (80%) Proportion of total assets allocated to grid trading GRID_MIN_ORDER_USD 5 Minimum notional amount per order (USD) GRID_MAX_PENDING_PER_SYMBOL 24 Maximum number of pending limit orders per symbol GRID_CLEANUP_BAND_MULT 1.5 Bandwidth multiplier for clearing orders far from the current price
paragraphs.zh: 环境变量 实验设置 含义 GRID_LEVELS 5 网格层级数量，包含高于和低于当前价格的五个层级 GRID_STEP_PCT 0.01（1%）相邻层级之间的相对间隔，采用乘法间距方式 GRID_CAPITAL_USAGE 0.8（80%）分配给网格交易的总资产比例 GRID_MIN_ORDER_USD 5 每笔订单的最小名义金额（美元） GRID_MAX_PENDING_PER_SYMBOL 24 每个符号的最大待执行限价单数量 GRID_CLEANUP_BAND_MULT 1.5 清理远离当前价格订单时的带宽乘数

paragraphs.en: This section specifies the runtime implementation underlying the environment and controlled agent configurations introduced in Sections 2.1 and 2.2 . It describes decision-round execution, trace recording, tool routing, persistent memory, rule-aware interaction, and the hierarchical multi-agent workflow; capability metrics are defined separately in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节规定了第 2.1 节和第 2.2 节中介绍的环境及受控智能体配置所依赖的运行时实现。 它描述了决策轮执行、轨迹记录、工具路由、持久化内存、规则感知交互以及分层多智能体工作流程；能力指标在附录 B.4 中单独定义。

sents.en: This section specifies the runtime implementation underlying the environment and controlled agent configurations introduced in Sections 2.1 and 2.2 .
sents.zh: 本节规定了第 2.1 节和第 2.2 节中介绍的环境及受控智能体配置所依赖的运行时实现。

sents.en: It describes decision-round execution, trace recording, tool routing, persistent memory, rule-aware interaction, and the hierarchical multi-agent workflow; capability metrics are defined separately in Appendix B.4 .
sents.zh: 它描述了决策轮执行、轨迹记录、工具路由、持久化内存、规则感知交互以及分层多智能体工作流程；能力指标在附录 B.4 中单独定义。

paragraphs.en: All agent configurations operate through a sequence of decision rounds . A decision round is one complete agent invocation and serves as the common execution structure across all configurations. We describe this shared runtime using the Base configuration , the simplest single-agent instantiation. The capability-specific configurations in Sections B.3.2 – B.3.5 preserve the same decision-round structure while introducing different mechanisms within it.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体配置都通过一系列决策轮次运行。 一个决策轮次是一次完整的智能体调用，并作为所有配置中通用的执行结构。 我们使用“基础”配置来描述这种共享的运行环境，它是最简单的单智能体实例化形式。 B.3.2 – B.3.5 节中针对特定能力的配置保留了相同的决策轮次结构，但在此结构中引入了不同的机制。

sents.en: All agent configurations operate through a sequence of decision rounds .
sents.zh: 所有智能体配置都通过一系列决策轮次运行。

sents.zh: 一个决策轮次是一次完整的智能体调用，并作为所有配置中通用的执行结构。

sents.en: We describe this shared runtime using the Base configuration , the simplest single-agent instantiation.
sents.zh: 我们使用“基础”配置来描述这种共享的运行环境，它是最简单的单智能体实例化形式。

paragraphs.en: The Base configuration implements each decision round as a ReAct-style interaction over a fixed set of callable tools. These tools provide the agent with access to the persistent trading environment, including current market and account state, historical and external information, sandboxed analysis utilities, and trade execution. The same fixed interface remains available throughout the round and does not require tool discovery or routing. Table 5 summarizes the Base tool set.
paragraphs.zh: 基础配置将每个决策回合实现为在固定可用工具集上进行的 ReAct 风格交互。 这些工具使智能体能够访问持续的交易环境，包括当前市场和账户状态、历史及外部信息、沙盒分析工具以及交易执行功能。 在整个回合中，始终可以使用相同的固定接口，无需进行工具发现或路由。 表 5 总结了基础工具集。

sents.en: The Base configuration implements each decision round as a ReAct-style interaction over a fixed set of callable tools.
sents.zh: 基础配置将每个决策回合实现为在固定可用工具集上进行的 ReAct 风格交互。

sents.en: These tools provide the agent with access to the persistent trading environment, including current market and account state, historical and external information, sandboxed analysis utilities, and trade execution.
sents.zh: 这些工具使智能体能够访问持续的交易环境，包括当前市场和账户状态、历史及外部信息、沙盒分析工具以及交易执行功能。

sents.zh: 在整个回合中，始终可以使用相同的固定接口，无需进行工具发现或路由。

sents.en: Table 5 summarizes the Base tool set.
sents.zh: 表 5 总结了基础工具集。

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of each decision round , the runtime injects the current timestamp (UTC+8), while the market and account state produced by previous rounds remain persistent. The agent then interacts with the environment through the tools in Table 5 . Following the ReAct scaffold, it reasons about its current information needs, invokes appropriate tools, observes their returned results, and uses those observations to determine its next step. For example, the agent may inspect its portfolio through get_account_state , observe current prices through get_market_snapshot , review previous decisions through get_history_decisions , gather additional market or external evidence through get_kline_history and consult_search_agent , or perform further analysis with the sandboxed file, shell, and Python tools.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个决策回合的开始，运行时系统会注入当前时间戳（UTC+8），而前几轮生成的市场和账户状态则会持续保留。 随后，智能体通过表 5 中的工具与环境进行交互。 遵循 ReAct 框架，它会推理当前的信息需求，调用合适的工具，观察其返回的结果，并利用这些观察结果确定下一步行动。 例如，智能体可以通过 get_account_state 检查其投资组合，通过 get_market_snapshot 观察当前价格，通过 get_history_decisions 回顾过往决策，通过 get_kline_history 和 consult_search_agent 收集更多市场或外部证据，或者使用沙盒化的文件、 shell 和 Python 工具进行进一步分析。

paragraphs.en: When the accumulated evidence supports a trading action, the agent may call execute_trade ; the execution result is then returned as another tool observation and becomes part of the context for subsequent reasoning. The agent may therefore reassess its portfolio, gather further evidence, or execute additional trading actions within the same decision round. In other words, calling execute_trade does not itself terminate the round. A decision round may contain multiple such interaction steps and multiple calls to execute_trade .
paragraphs.zh: 当累积的证据支持某种交易操作时，智能体可以调用 execute_trade；执行结果随后会作为另一个工具观察结果返回，并成为后续推理上下文的一部分。 因此，智能体可以在同一决策回合内重新评估其投资组合、收集更多证据或执行额外的交易操作。 换言之，调用 execute_trade 本身并不会结束该回合。 一个决策回合可能包含多个此类交互步骤以及对 execute_trade 的多次调用。

paragraphs.en: The round terminates when the agent determines that the overall decision process is complete and emits the designated termination token <TRADE_DONE> , or when the configured execution budget is exhausted. Under either termination condition, the resulting cash, positions, and other account state are preserved rather than reset and remain part of the environment observed in subsequent rounds. A sequence of decision rounds therefore forms the agent’s persistent trading trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体判定整个决策过程已完成并发出指定的终止标记 <TRADE_DONE> 时，或当配置的执行预算耗尽时，该回合即告结束。 无论处于哪种终止条件，产生的现金、头寸及其他账户状态均会被保留而非重置，并继续作为后续回合中环境观察的一部分存在。 因此，一系列决策回合共同构成了智能体持续的交易轨迹。

paragraphs.en: For each decision round , the runtime records the ordered sequence of model responses, tool calls, tool outputs, and trading actions as its decision trace . These traces provide the within-round process records used by the capability-specific evaluations in Appendix B.4 . Account values are recorded independently of decision-round execution, as described in Appendix B.1 . This allows trading outcomes to be evaluated at fixed time intervals even though agents make decisions less frequently. The complete Base system prompt is provided in Appendix A.3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在每个决策回合中，运行时都会记录模型响应、工具调用、工具输出和交易动作的有序序列，作为其决策轨迹。 这些轨迹提供了回合内的过程记录，供附录 B.4 中的特定能力评估使用。 账户价值独立于决策回合的执行过程进行记录，具体说明见附录 B.1。 这样即使智能体决策频率较低，交易结果也能在固定的时间间隔内得到评估。 完整的 Base 系统提示词见附录 A.3.1。

sents.en: The complete Base system prompt is provided in Appendix A.3.1 .
sents.zh: 完整的 Base 系统提示词见附录 A.3.1。

paragraphs.en: The Tool use configuration retains the decision-round and ReAct execution structure described in Section B.3.1 , including persistent account state and the integration of trade execution into the within-round interaction. Its primary modification is the tool-access mechanism: instead of relying only on the fixed Base tool set, the agent can dynamically discover and activate additional tools from a substantially larger heterogeneous catalog.
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用配置保留了 B.3.1 节中描述的决策回合和 ReAct 执行结构，包括持久的账户状态以及将交易执行整合到回合内交互中。 其主要修改在于工具访问机制：智能体不再仅依赖固定的基础工具集，而是可以从一个规模大得多的异构工具目录中动态发现并激活额外工具。

sents.en: The Tool use configuration retains the decision-round and ReAct execution structure described in Section B.3.1 , including persistent account state and the integration of trade execution into the within-round interaction.
sents.zh: 工具使用配置保留了 B.3.1 节中描述的决策回合和 ReAct 执行结构，包括持久的账户状态以及将交易执行整合到回合内交互中。

sents.en: Its primary modification is the tool-access mechanism: instead of relying only on the fixed Base tool set, the agent can dynamically discover and activate additional tools from a substantially larger heterogeneous catalog.
sents.zh: 其主要修改在于工具访问机制：智能体不再仅依赖固定的基础工具集，而是可以从一个规模大得多的异构工具目录中动态发现并激活额外工具。

paragraphs.en: The expanded catalog contains 295 295 additional tool interfaces derived from a fixed snapshot of the APIVerve public-apis repository [ APIVerve, 2026 ] , with its OpenAPI specifications serving as the source interface definitions. We preserve these public schemas while implementing execution locally within LiveMACEBench , providing stable availability and traceable outputs. Together with the 10 10 Base tools listed in Table 5 , they form a candidate space of 305 305 tools; select_tools serves only as the routing meta-tool and is not counted as a candidate tool.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展后的目录包含 295 个新增工具接口，这些接口源自 APIVerve public-apis 仓库的固定快照 [APIVerve, 2026]，其 OpenAPI 规范用作源接口定义。 我们在 LiveMACEBench 内部本地实现执行的同时，保留了这些公共模式，从而确保了稳定的可用性和可追溯的输出结果。 结合表 5 中列出的 10 个基础工具，它们共同构成了一个包含 305 个工具的候选空间；select_tools 仅用作路由元工具，不计入候选工具数量。

paragraphs.en: Five execution-critical Base tools remain directly available throughout every decision round : get_market_snapshot , get_kline_history , get_account_state , get_history_decisions , and execute_trade . Consequently, the agent can always observe the core market and account state and execute trading actions without first invoking the router. When the agent requires additional tools for its current information need, it expresses that need through select_tools . The routing call does not itself retrieve task evidence or perform the requested analysis. Instead, it returns a subset of candidate tools that becomes available for subsequent calls alongside the directly available tools.

sents.en: Consequently, the agent can always observe the core market and account state and execute trading actions without first invoking the router.

paragraphs.en: The agent may then invoke one or more of the returned tools, whose outputs are incorporated as observations into the ongoing ReAct interaction. If these observations reveal another information need, the agent may call select_tools again, refreshing the routed subset without leaving the current decision round. Routing and trading therefore do not form paired or sequentially fixed stages: a single round may contain multiple routing requests before a trading action, additional routing after a trade, or multiple trading actions interleaved with further evidence gathering. From the agent’s perspective, select_tools , directly available tools, routed tools, and execute_trade are all callable actions within the same ReAct interaction, with each call determining the next observation and subsequent reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体随后可以调用一个或多个返回的工具，其输出将作为观察结果整合到正在进行的 ReAct 交互中。 如果这些观察结果揭示了新的信息需求，智能体可以再次调用 select_tools，在不离开当前决策轮次的前提下刷新已路由的子集。 因此，路由和交易并非构成成对或顺序固定的阶段：单个轮次可能包含多次路由请求后才执行一次交易动作，交易中也可能出现额外的路由操作，或者多次交易动作与进一步的证据收集交替进行。 从智能体的角度来看，select_tools、直接可用的工具、已路由的工具以及 execute_trade 都是同一 ReAct 交互中可被调用的动作，每次调用都会决定下一个观察结果及后续的推理过程。

paragraphs.en: Router outputs are validated before the returned tools are made available to the agent. Malformed or insufficient routing results trigger another routing attempt; duplicate tool names are deduplicated before activation, and names outside the registered catalog are excluded from the activated tool subset. These validation steps affect which tools become callable, rather than whether the routing attempt is recorded. Once the agent attempts a tool call, the call and its returned result are retained in the decision trace regardless of whether the call succeeds, fails, or produces an invalid, empty, or erroneous result. The recorded traces are subsequently used for the Tool Use evaluation in Appendix B.4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在将返回的工具提供给智能体之前，路由器输出会经过验证。 格式错误或不充分的路由结果会触发另一次路由尝试；在激活之前，重复的工具名称会被去重，而名称不在已注册目录中的工具则会被排除在已激活的工具子集之外。 这些验证步骤会影响哪些工具可以被调用，而不是路由尝试是否被记录。 一旦智能体尝试调用某个工具，无论该调用成功、失败，还是产生无效、为空或错误的结果，此次调用及其返回的结果都会被保留在决策轨迹中。 随后，这些记录的轨迹将用于附录 B.4.1 中的工具使用评估。

paragraphs.en: The Persistent memory configuration retains the decision-round structure and ReAct interaction of the Base configuration , while adding two memory tools, memory_search and memory_add . These tools are available within the same interaction as the Base tools. memory_search retrieves reusable experience accumulated in earlier decision rounds , while memory_add stores new experience for later rounds. The memory store persists across decision rounds , is scoped by account and market, and is initialized empty at the beginning of an evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 持久内存配置保留了基础配置的决策轮次结构和 ReAct 交互方式，同时增加了两个内存工具：memory_search 和 memory_add。 这些工具可在与基础工具相同的交互中使用。memory_search 用于检索先前决策轮次中积累的可用经验，而 memory_add 则用于存储新经验以备后续轮次使用。 内存存储贯穿各个决策轮次，其作用范围由账户和市场限定，并在每次评估开始时初始化为空。

paragraphs.en: where [CONDITION] describes the market or portfolio state, [OBSERVATION] captures the subsequent market behavior or outcome observed under that condition, and [RULE] distills an actionable principle for similar future situations. Each entry is also tagged with its market domain (i.e., cryptocurrency and U.S. equity markets ), so that accumulated experience remains grounded in the market context in which it was acquired rather than being indiscriminately reused across markets.

paragraphs.en: As the same decision round proceeds, the agent is also instructed to consider whether the current experience is sufficiently reusable to retain for the future. If so, it calls memory_add with a candidate entry in the representation above. Before insertion, the candidate is compared with existing entries with the same market tag. If its maximum embedding cosine similarity to an existing entry is at least 0.9 0.9 , it is treated as a near duplicate and is not added; otherwise, it is committed to the persistent store and becomes available for retrieval in subsequent decision rounds . Both memory_search and memory_add are therefore ordinary tool interactions within the current decision round rather than separate stages that terminate or restart the decision process.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一决策轮次中，智能体还被指示考虑当前经验是否足够可复用，以便在未来保留。 如果是，它会调用 memory_add，并使用上述表示中的一个候选条目。 在插入之前，该候选条目会与具有相同市场标签的现有条目进行比较。 如果它与某个现有条目的最大嵌入余弦相似度至少为 0.9，则被视为近似重复项而不会被添加；否则，它将被提交到持久化存储中，并在后续决策轮次中可供检索。 因此，memory_search 和 memory_add 都是当前决策轮次内的普通工具交互，而不是会终止或重启决策过程的独立阶段。

paragraphs.en: Within each decision round , the agent gathers market, portfolio, historical, and external evidence using the same tool interaction as in Base . It is then instructed to identify the rules relevant to the current situation, determine whether they constrain the intended action, and account for any conflicts before executing trades. R ​ 0 R0 and R ​ 1 R1 are treated as hard boundaries, while R ​ 2 R2 preferences may be traded off against one another or against the expected benefit of a trade as long as the higher-priority requirements remain satisfied.

paragraphs.en: Before executing trades, the agent must provide a structured compliance rationale containing three parts: [Reasoning & Market View] , [Compliance Audit] , and [Conflict Resolution] . For every rule it checks, the compliance audit records the rule identifier, a Pass , Fail , or Adjusted status, and a brief explanation. Relevant conflicts must be stated explicitly together with the reasoning used to resolve them; if no conflict is identified, the agent reports that no rule conflict was detected.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行交易之前，智能体必须提供一个结构化的合规性理由说明，包含三个部分：[推理与市场观点]、[合规审计] 和 [冲突解决]。 对于每一条被检查的规则，合规性审计都会记录该规则的标识符、通过/失败/调整状态以及简要说明。 相关的冲突必须明确说明，并附上用于解决这些冲突的推理过程；如果未识别出任何冲突，智能体应报告未检测到规则冲突。

paragraphs.en: After producing this rationale, the agent may invoke execute_trade one or more times as required by the decision. paragraphs.en: The Multi-Agent configuration preserves the Base decision-round boundary and persistent account state, while replacing the Base agent’s single-agent decision process with a manager-led interaction involving five specialist agents and a separate ExecutionAgent. The same backbone model is used for the Manager and specialist agents, while role definitions, prompts, tool permissions, and the interaction protocol are fixed across evaluated backbones. Unlike the Base configuration , tool access is partitioned by role: the Manager has no direct market-data or trade-execution tools, specialists access only the tools assigned to their roles, and trade execution is delegated to ExecutionAgent. Table 6 summarizes these responsibilities and permissions.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体配置保留了基础决策轮次边界和持久化账户状态，同时将基础智能体的单智能体决策过程替换为一种由管理器主导的交互流程，该流程涉及五个专业智能体和一个独立的执行智能体。 管理器和专业智能体均使用相同的骨干模型，而角色定义、提示词、工具权限以及交互协议在所有评估的骨干模型中保持一致。 与基础配置不同，工具访问权限按角色划分：管理器没有直接访问市场数据或交易执行工具的权限，专业智能体仅能使用分配给其角色的工具，而交易执行则委托给执行智能体完成。 表6总结了这些职责和权限。

paragraphs.en: To illustrate how the Multi-Agent configuration operates within a decision round , consider how the Manager gathers the information needed to form a trading plan. Because the Manager has no direct access to market or account data, every round includes at least one call to TradingAgent, which provides the market and portfolio view needed to ground the decision. The Manager may then call NewsAgent, CoderAgent, AnalystAgent, or CriticAgent when the current decision requires recent-event evidence, quantitative verification, reconciliation of conflicting evidence, or an explicit downside challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 为了说明多智能体配置在决策轮次中如何运作，可以考虑经理如何收集制定交易计划所需的信息。 由于经理无法直接访问市场或账户数据，因此每一轮都至少需要调用一次交易智能体，以获取用于支撑决策所需的市场和组合视图。 随后，当当前决策需要近期事件证据、定量验证、对冲突证据的协调或明确的负面挑战时，经理可以调用新闻智能体、编码智能体、分析智能体或评论智能体。

paragraphs.en: The resulting evidence items are returned to the Manager, which may request additional specialist input if important information is still missing or proceed to a final decision once the available evidence is sufficient. When finishing, the Manager identifies the evidence supporting its decision and produces an ordered execution_plan ; the corresponding evidence identifiers are retained with the final decision. The Manager is allocated a budget of 100 steps, each specialist invocation is limited to 20 model turns, and NewsAgent may issue at most three search calls per invocation. If no valid plan is produced within the available budget, the round falls back to a conservative no-trade decision.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的证据项将被返回给管理器；如果仍有重要信息缺失，管理器可能会请求额外的专家意见，或者在可用证据充分时进入最终决策阶段。 流程结束时，管理器会确定支持其决策的证据，并生成一个有序的执行计划；相应的证据标识符将与最终决策一同保留。 管理器被分配了 100 步的预算，每次专家调用最多限制为 20 次模型轮次，且 NewsAgent 每次调用最多只能发起三次搜索请求。 如果在可用预算内未能生成有效的计划，该轮次将回退至保守的“不交易”决策。

paragraphs.en: The completed plan is then passed to ExecutionAgent together with the decision basis, current portfolio, and market prices. ExecutionAgent processes the plan items in their specified order through execute_trade ; a single plan may therefore produce multiple trade calls, while an empty plan completes without placing a trade. After all plan items have been processed, ExecutionAgent emits <TRADE_DONE> , completing the decision round.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，完整的计划连同决策依据、当前投资组合和市场价格一起传递给执行智能体。 执行智能体通过 execute_trade 按照指定顺序处理计划中的各项内容；因此，一个计划可能产生多个交易指令，而空计划则无需执行任何交易即可完成。 所有计划内容处理完毕后，执行智能体会发出 <TRADE_DONE>，从而结束当前决策回合。

paragraphs.en: This section specifies the definition and computation procedures for the capability-specific dimensions introduced in Section 2.3 . Judge prompts and scoring rubrics are provided separately in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 本节明确了第 2.3 节中引入的能力特定维度的定义与计算流程。 判断提示词与评分标准在附录 A 中单独提供。

sents.en: This section specifies the definition and computation procedures for the capability-specific dimensions introduced in Section 2.3 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each complete Tool-Augmented decision trace along the following four dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们从以下四个维度评估每条完整的工具增强决策轨迹：

paragraphs.en: Tool Relevance (TR) : Measures whether the selected tools address the information needs of the current decision.
paragraphs.zh: 工具相关性（TR）：衡量所选工具是否满足当前决策的信息需求。

paragraphs.en: Invocation Efficiency (IE) : Measures whether tool calls are made at appropriate times without unnecessary repetition, premature stopping, or wasteful use of the tool budget.
paragraphs.zh: 调用效率（IE）：衡量工具调用是否在适当的时间进行，且没有不必要的重复、过早停止或浪费工具预算的情况。

paragraphs.en: Information Coverage (IC) : Measures whether the trace gathers sufficient evidence to support the decision.
paragraphs.zh: 信息覆盖度（IC）：衡量追踪过程是否收集了足以支持决策的充分证据。

paragraphs.en: Evidence Faithfulness (EF) : Measures whether the agent’s subsequent reasoning and decision are supported by the returned tool outputs, rather than relying on unsupported or contradictory claims.
paragraphs.zh: 证据保真性（EF）：衡量智能体的后续推理和决策是否由返回的工具输出所支持，而非依赖缺乏依据或相互矛盾的说法。

paragraphs.en: The judge prompt is presented in Appendix A.3.3 , with each dimension rated on a 0 0 – 10 10 scale. Each raw judge rating is divided by 10 to obtain the corresponding metric on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Throughout the evaluation, TR , IE , IC , and EF denote these normalized scores. For each backbone, we report the mean score for each dimension across all evaluated Tool-Augmented traces. We use Qwen3.5-397B-A17B as the primary judge; DeepSeek-V4-Pro evaluates the same traces for the cross-judge robustness analysis in Appendix C.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 法官提示词见附录 A.3.3，每个维度均按 0–10 的评分标准进行评级。 每个原始法官评分除以 10，得到 [0,1] 区间内的对应指标值。 在整个评估过程中，TR、IE、IC 和 EF 分别表示这些归一化后的分数。 对于每个基础模型，我们报告了所有经过评估的工具增强轨迹中各维度的平均得分。 我们将 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 作为主要法官；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 则用于评估相同的轨迹，以进行附录 C.3 中的跨法官稳健性分析。
